title: Blog page (list of articles)
evidence: the article list closed by the subscription on about 1 in 2 blog pages

steps.note: A page heading (it becomes the H1), 3 columns with a big first row, one article per phone row.
Bestsellers, or the collection the articles talk about: a reader from search gets to the products.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: Link the blog from the home page (`FeaturedBlogs`) only when there are 3 or more published articles.
